detail.title: Dahua 16MP All-in-One Enforcement Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC1652-AU5F-IRL8ZF1640-P Dahua 16MP All-in-One Enforcement Camera Key Points • 9MP Ultra HD with 1.1-inch Global Sensor • Covers up to 3 Lanes in All-day Infrared Mode • Vehicle Analytics and Classfication • Driver Behavior Analytics and Face Capture • Smart Violation Detection • IP66 Waterproof and IK10 Vandal Proof • Capture Vehicles at Speeds up to 300km/h Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Camera.Shutter Mode: Single shutter; Double shutters; Three shutters
Camera.Day/Night: ICR auto switch: Use the IR transmitting filter during the daytime and nighttime.

Illuminator.Lane Coverage: Center mount: 5 lanes Side mount: 4 lanes

Function.OSD Overlay: Time; address; lane No.; plate; plate color; and more
Function.Alarm Event: Storage full; storage error; external alarm; no storage card; license plate blocklist; illegal access; network disconnection; IP conflict
Function.Automatic Network Replenishment (ANR): Platform and FTP (TF card is required)

Intelligence.Face Detection: Detects the driver and front-seat passenger of motor vehicles, and motorcycle drivers; extracts face images
Intelligence.ANPR: Adopts developed algorithms to recognize license plate numbers and letters
Intelligence.Vehicle Type Recognition: Vehicle head: SUV, Large bus, sedan, light truck, pickup, heavy truck, medium truck, van, medium bus, MPV Vehicle tail: SUV, large bus, sedan, light truck, pickup, heavy truck, medium truck, van
Intelligence.Vehicle Brand/Logo Recognition: Vehicle head mode: Acura, Alfaromeo, Ashokleyland, Astonmartin, Audi, Baic, Bently, Benz, BMW, Buick, BYD, Cadillac, Chery, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Citroen, Dacia, Daihatsu, Datsun, Dodge, DS, Ferrari, Fiat, Force, Ford, Foton, Geely, GMC, Greatwall, Hino, Honda, Hyundai, Infiniti, Isuzu, Iveco, Jac, Jaguar, Jeep, Kia, Kinglong, Land, Lexus, Lifan, Lincoln, Mahindra, MAN, Maserati, Mazda, Mercury, MG, Mini, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Opel, Peugeot, Porsche, Renault, Rollsroyce, Saab, Scania, Seat, Skoda, Smart, Subaru, Suzuki, Tata, Tesla, Toyota, UD, Volkswagen, Volvo
Intelligence.Motor Vehicle Violation Capture: ANPR mode: Wrong-way driving, speeding, driving slow, crossing the solid white line, crossing the solid yellow line, illegal lane change, unfasten seat belt, calling while driving, smoking while driving
Intelligence.Motorcycle Violation Capture: Captures traffic violations including carrying passenger, not wearing helmet, and wrong-way driving
Intelligence.Traffic Flow Detection: Generates statistics on vehicle flow, queue length, average speed, lane occupancy, and more
Intelligence.Traffic Event: Motor vehicle illegal stopping on the roadway; traffic congestion

Video.Video Frame Rate: 50Hz: Maximum 25 fps; default main stream (4096 × 2160@12.5fps), sub stream (1600 × 1200@12.5 fps) 30Hz: Maximum 30 fps; default main stream (4096 × 2160@15 fps), sub stream (1600 × 1200@15 fps)
Video.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–32767 kbps H.265: 32 kbps–32767 kbps MJPEG: 512 kbps–32767 kbps

Image.Composite Image: Supports combining up to 4 images into a composite image
Image.Image Tampering Prevention: Verifies watermarks in videos and images

Network.Network Port: 2 × RJ-45 Ethernet ports, 10/100/1000 M network transmission
Network.Security: Authorized username and password, MAC address binding, HTTPS encryption, and network access control
Network.Network Protocol: IPv4/IPv6; HTTP; TCP/IP; UDP; NTP; DHCP
Network.Browser: Microsoft Edge IE: IE9–IE11 Chrome: Chrome 41 and earlier Firefox: Firefox 49 and earlier For Win 10 users, run the browser as administrator

Port.Iris Control: 1, connects to DC auto iris or P-IRIS
Port.Frequency Source Sync: 1, supports synchronizing the camera with the mains electricity
Port.Peripheral Light: 7, optocoupler signal output (can be configured as flash light or LED strobe sync output interface, frequency adjustable)
Port.RS-485: 2, connects to devices such as signal detector, radar, and more
Port.RS-232: 4 (3 for radar connection, and 1 for serial port debugging)
Port.I/O: 4, same functions as ALARM IN port
Port.Alarm Output: 2 (AO1 is for relay output and AO2 for optocoupler output)
Port.Power Output: 12 VDC ± 10% voltage output, ≤1.5 A current output
